description:
## Goal
Move the private `Fetcher::LoopState` class out of `src/vug/fetcher.cr` into a dedicated file.

## Why (SRP)
`fetcher.cr` currently defines a 22-line state container (`LoopState`) in addition to the fetch loop. The class is only used by `Fetcher` itself, so it doesn't need to be inside `fetcher.cr`. Moving it to its own file:
- Lets `LoopState` be unit-tested in isolation (it has its own invariants and `MAX_GRAY_ATTEMPTS`).
- Makes `fetcher.cr` easier to scan top-to-bottom.
- Sets a precedent for splitting unrelated types out of "main" files.

## Approach
1. Create `src/vug/loop_state.cr` (file name aligned with other types in the project).
2. Move the `class LoopState` block (lines 43-65 of `src/vug/fetcher.cr`) verbatim to the new file, inside `module Vug`.
3. Add `require "./loop_state"` to `fetcher.cr`.
4. Change references from `Fetcher::LoopState` (if any, internal) to `Vug::LoopState`. Internal references are all `LoopState` (without prefix) and don't need updating.
5. Re-export from the top-level `src/vug.cr` so consumers can require it via the umbrella file.

## Acceptance
- `LoopState` is defined in `src/vug/loop_state.cr`, not in `fetcher.cr`.
- All fetcher specs pass (`crystal spec spec/vug/fetcher_spec.cr spec/vug/fetcher_logic_spec.cr`).
- `crystal tool format` and `ameba` show no new violations.
- No public API change.

## Notes
- Keep the `MAX_GRAY_ATTEMPTS = 3` constant inside `LoopState` for now; it is the subject of a separate ticket (`vugcr-mri`).
title: Extract LoopState class to its own file
